meta.title: Super-DeepSeek-Harness Git
meta.description: One-click sync of your DeepSeek Harness profile (config, skills, plugin data, sessions) to a private GitHub repository, and restore it on any new machine. Sign in with a fine-grained personal access token; the token is stored in the encrypted credential store, never in configuration. Sidebar GitHub icon opens: account, Sync now (with progress), Settings (choose what to sync), Sign out, Uninstall guide.

menu.needRepo: Set the repository in Settings first
